title: Kestrel and the Terminal
author: Cyrus Hartwell
blurb: Ansel Underhill, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
